correctness.rationale: The 256 vertices 2^a3^b5^c7^d (0≤a,b,c,d<4) are distinct. Exact integer square-root testing exhausts all C(256,2)=32640 potential edges and yields exactly 408 forbidden Pythagorean pairs (unrestricted positive integer hypotenuse). An independent reimplementation using arbitrary-precision integer square roots checked the package CERTIFICATE.json blob 98ed409b09047a1950d23bc6cb581e93fb0d4c9b: it contains 144 distinct indices containing no forbidden edge and 112 true graph edges on 224 mutually different endpoints. This is a genuine finite exhaustive certificate: independent set yields f(4)≥144, disjoint-edge matching requires omitting at least one endpoint per pair, f(4)≤256−112=144. No numerical approximation, SAT proof assumption or non-exhaustive random search enters the equality. The prior verify.py checker was inspected as code, not executed opaquely.
